programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: The Smurfs

Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs

The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs

He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Laundry Day
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Princess or Dragon?
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn't you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Well-beeing
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: How to Train Your Plant
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Recipe For Disaster
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: The Mystery Guest
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the quartet W24! This band burst into the music scene in March 2018 with the song Always Missing You. Composed of vocalist Cheong Ho-won guitarist Kim Yun-soo keyboardist Aaron Park and drummer Kim Jong-gil they compose write and produce all the songs they release and perform. Their name is short for World 24 Hours expressing the band's desire for their music to be heard 24 hours a day around the world. Thanks to their outstanding talents W24 won the Focus Award at the Asia Artist Awards in 2018 and the Best K-Pop Rookie Award at the 2019 Korea Culture Entertainment Grande Prize. Also they participated in The Asian Top Band a project to discover world-class musicians involving 8 Asian countries as the Korean representatives and became the winners. In this episode W24 performs Once Upon A Time Breath Under The Tree and more to show off thier musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Zitten! This artist made his debut in 2005 with the EP Rock Doves and has been nourishing the hearts of countless listeners with his delicate lyrical lyrics and heartwarming music since then. Also known for drawing his inspiration from various everyday elements he comforts our souls in a calm yet powerful way. Last December Zitten released the Christmas song All You Need Is A Carol to tell us not to take anything for granted. Then in January this year he started a new project to produce music inspired by places he visited books he read things he purchased and films he watched. The very first outcome of that new project is the song Little forest which he performs on I'm LIVE. He also performs Let's do well Something to say and more to showcase the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and meet Zitten!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Choi Gonne! Choi Gonne burst into the music scene in 2010 with the EP 36.5°. Since then she has covered numerous genres of music ranging from folk music rock and jazz not to mention pansori that she learned to sing when she was a child. She's also known for her mix of melodic acoustic themes powerful vocals and sheer lyrical prowess which together make her one of a kind. Last but not least she's the first Korean artist to be invited three times to perform at the Glastonbury Festival in the U.K. In this episode Choi Gonne performs ‘HIGHLANDER' ‘Eric's song' and more to display the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and meet Choi Gonne!

He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Emerald Forest-Return Of The Tigers
programme.desc: Emerald Forest: The Panna National Park Is The 22Nd Tiger Reserve Of India And Contains The Last Remaining Tiger Habitat Of North Madhya Pradesh. In 2009, Over 40 Tigers Disappeared Mainly Due To Poaching And Global Warming. The Forest Management Was Quick To Come Up With A Dynamic Plan That Dealt With The Threat, And In Less Than 10 Years, The Panna Reserve Once Again Has More Than 50 Tigers. A Story Set In The Midst Of Wild Canvases Of Planet Earth And Shot In Ultra High Definition (4K) Emerald Forest - Return Of The Tigers Celebrates A Decade Of The Amazing Success That Will Forever Be Etched In The Conservationists Hall Of Fame As It Explores The Rich Flora And Fauna Of The Region And Other Wildlife Attractions.

programme.title: The Way Back Home

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

L'ordine provoca scontento, che si trasforma in gioia quando dall'aereo americano scendono venti avvenenti ausiliarie, capitanate da Rebecca O'Connor.

programme.title: Guardia, ladro e cameriera
programme.desc: Spassoso film comico con Nino Manfredi, Mario Carotenuto e Luciano Salce. La notte di San Silvestro, un giovane squattrinato si lascia coinvolgere dagli amici a tentare un colpo in un lussuoso appartamento, che sarebbe dovuto essere vuoto. A complicare la situazione ci penseranno una guardia notturna e una cameriera che rischieranno di finire nei guai.

programme.title: I Cuori Infranti
programme.desc: Una divertente commedia che rompe i classici schemi dell'amore. Il film è diviso in due episodi: nel primo, protagonista è una ragazza che riesce a impedire le nozze dell'amato con una rivale. Nel secondo, l'equilibrio di una perfetta famiglia si regge sul ruolo casalingo di lui, e su quello di lei, che procura i soldi tramite attività poco convenzionali.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari!
programme.desc: Film comico diretto da Mario Costa con i grandi Nino Taranto ed Alberto Sordi. Cinque fratelli scoprono che uno zio morto in Sudafrica ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi, Nino Manfredi e Ugo Tognazzi in una divertente commedia composta da tre episodi. Un timido impiegato riesce a dichiarare le sue intenzioni sentimentali a una collega un alto funzionario cerca di far sparire le tracce di un filmato compromettente un partecipante a un concorso, dotato di una brutta dentatura, mette in crisi i tentativi di boicottaggio da parte della commissione.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Il prigioniero di Amsterdam (aka Corrispondente 17)
programme.desc: Poco prima dello scoppio della seconda Guerra Mondiale, un giovane reporter americano scopre un complotto: un anziano leader del movimento pacifista internazionale viene rapito dai nazisti. A capo del complotto c'è un finto pacifista inglese, in realtà gerarca nazista. Quando il primo viene liberato, la guerra è ormai scoppiata l'inglese muore durante un attacco aereo mentre sua figlia e il reporter si salvano.

programme.title: La fontana della vergine
programme.desc: Un racconto straziante di fede, vendetta e ferocia nella Svezia medievale

programme.title: Le avventure galanti del giovane Molière
programme.desc: Nei bassifondi di Sin City, Dwight medita vendetta nei confronti di Ava Lord, la donna che l'ha tradito e incastrato. Intanto Nancy cerca di venire a capo del suo dolore per la morte del detective Hartigan.

programme.title: IL CLUB DELL'AMORE: IL VIAGGIO DI SYDNEY
programme.desc: Sydney è un'ex atleta che ora fa la food blogger. In tutto questo, nel suo cuore non sembra mai essere passata la cotta per Theo, suo ex cmpagno di college. E rivedersi dopo 10 anni cambierà qualcosa?

programme.title: PICNIC A HANGING ROCK
programme.desc: Dal regista de L'attimo fuggente, The Truman Show, Master & Commander, un dramma avvolto nel mistero che si consuma nel primo San Valentino del '900. Le ragazze del collegio di Appleyard si recano in gita ad Hanging Rock, una suggestiva formazione rocciosa. Tre delle fanciulle scompaiono misteriosamente e a nulla valgono le ricerche. Cosa accadde quel giorno di S. Valentino è ancora un mistero…

programme.title: I Toni dell'Amore
programme.desc: Ben (John Lithgow) e Jorge (Alfred Molina), due omosessuali che stanno insieme da 28 anni, decidono finalmente di sposarsi. Quando però uno dei due perde inaspettatamente il proprio lavoro in una scuola cattolica locale, Ben e Jorge si ritrovano costretti a rinunciare al loro appartamento e a vivere separati, mettendo a dura prova il loro amore.

programme.title: UNA FIGLIA DA SALVARE
programme.desc: Hallie è una neo-mamma devota alla figlia che ha subito un trapianto di cuore. Una volta tornate a casa, però, l'ambiente intorno a lei comincia a farsi oppressivo e inquietante: strani soggetti la seguono per la strada finchè il suo incubo peggiore non si avvera

programme.title: QUEEN OF THE DESERT
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, personaggio realmente esistito è una donna inglese dalla vita ricca e avventurosa che, all'alba del XX secolo, fu viaggiatrice, scrittrice, archeologa, esploratrice, cartografa, agente segreto e diplomatica per conto dell'Impero Britannico.

programme.title: Bad blood
programme.desc: Hannah è bionda, carina e incastrata in una vita buia e sporca, fatta di droghe, spaccio e illegalità in tutte le sue declinazioni. Sulle sue spalle, grava la responsabilità dell'intera famiglia, coinvolta in affari illeciti e amori impossibili.

programme.title: Otto secondi di gloria
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica sulla vita di Lane Frost, celebre campione del rodeo. Dalla gioventù, quando Lane, grazie agli insegnamenti del padre, inizia a frequentare le gare, fino a diventare il migliore del mondo.

programme.title: A Circus Story and a Love Song
programme.desc: Refugio, un romantico sognatore la cui ricerca del vero amore, durata anni, lo porta dalla vita circense in Messico alla vita notturna di New Orleans, dove si innamora inaspettatamente di una bellissima ballerina esotica con un passato complicato.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Nove anni dopo l'occupazione degli alieni, due fratelli si sono persi di vista. Rafe è dato per morto, mentre Gabriel si prepara per la fuga dalla città, ma i suoi piani sono stravolti dal ritorno di Rafe e dalle azioni della resistenza.

programme.title: Una voce nella notte
programme.desc: Uno speaker radiofonico riceve strane telefonate da un ragazzo misterioso. Ma dietro la voce si nasconde un segreto inquietante. Thriller psicologico con Robin Williams.

programme.title: L'ora dolce dell'amore
programme.desc: Trish perde il suo appuntamento al buio con Adam e incontra erroneamente Parker. Quando scopre l'errore, però, è decisa a metterlo da parte. Mentre Parker cerca di convincerla a dargli una possibilità, lei lo tiene a debita distanza, anche se lentamente s'innamora di lui, fino a quando un malinteso li separa. Mesi dopo, il cambio dell'ora potrebbe dare loro la possibilità di sistemare le cose.

programme.title: Addestramento d'amore
programme.desc: Dopo aver commesso 73 errori sui vigili del fuoco nel suo ultimo romanzo rosa, l'editrice di Jo, Diana, insiste affinché trascorra settimane a fare ricerche per il suo prossimo libro, allenandosi in un campo militare gestito dal fratello navy seal.

programme.title: Un marito da addestrare
programme.desc: In questa divertente commedia romantica diretta da Sandra L. Martin, Julie Gonzalo (A Cinderella Story) veste i panni di Jilian, affermata scrittrice e consulente matrimoniale la cui vita sentimentale è in profonda crisi. Un giorno entra a far parte della sua vita Aron, un simpatico cagnolino, che avrà molto da insegnarle.

programme.title: Ricordati di te
programme.desc: Un affascinante sconosciuto perde la memoria dopo essere stato investito da una bibliofila in bicicletta.

programme.title: Il ragazzo dei miei sogni
programme.desc: Abby, orientata alla carriera, accetta di aiutare il suo capo impegnato a trovare l'uomo dei suoi sogni, ma incontra un dilemma quando inizia a innamorarsi dello stesso uomo con cui il suo capo approva gli appuntamenti.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Tre giovani donne in vacanza a Parigi si ritrovano catapultate a Monte Carlo dopo che una di esse viene scambiata per una ereditiera britannica.

programme.title: Un amore per sempre
programme.desc: Emma è un'organizzatrice di eventi che non ha tempo per l'amore, finché sua sorella non rivela che il suo matrimonio è tra sei settimane. Emma accetta di intervenire e pianificarlo da sola con l'aiuto di Liam, con cui Emma ha avuto un disastroso appuntamento al buio anni fa.

programme.title: La voce del cuore
programme.desc: La coach relazionale Sam crede di poter aggiustare qualsiasi storia d'amore e sta creando un podcast per dimostrarlo. Ma il vivace produttore Josh la sfida a mettere alla prova il suo stesso cuore.

programme.title: Il mio vero amore
programme.desc: Quando l'ex marito di Josie, Michael, entra nel suo negozio di fiori con un'irrifiutabile offerta d'affari, la donna si ritrova al centro di un brutale divorzio tra Michael e la sua ex moglie Cora, pazza autoproclamata, ed un divorzio pieno di sotterfugi e tradimenti. Josie dovrà stabilire chi è veramente la pazza, anche a costo di rischiare la propria vita.

programme.title: Un amore di damigella
programme.desc: La damigella d'onore professionista Cate James è entusiasta di aiutare la sua migliore amica con il giorno del matrimonio e incontra il bel fratello di Maxine, Matt, che è in città per il matrimonio di sua sorella. Scoccherà la scintilla tra Cate e Matt?

programme.title: Uno sposato sotto tiro
programme.desc: Il mondo di Michael viene sconvolto quando la compagna lo abbandona nel deserto, dove un adolescente gli ruba l'auto e viene preso in ostaggio durante una rapina al Sip and Zip locale.

programme.title: Innamorarsi al Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Stanca della vita frenetica che conduce in città, Sophie Carter si reca in una piccola cittadina di mare per staccare la spina e riflettere su se stessa, alloggiando in un Airbnb gestito dal padre vedovo di una bambina.

programme.title: Due cuori e una tenda
programme.desc: Durante un'inaspettata vacanza in campeggio organizzata all'ultimo minuto, due perfetti sconosciuti si ritrovano a condividere la stessa tenda per errore. Tra disastri comici, notti sotto le stelle e momenti inaspettatamente teneri, scoprono che forse l'amore si nasconde nei luoghi più improbabili.

programme.title: Amore a Crystal Cove
programme.desc: SKYE si sta preparando ad un altro grande anno della sua attività "Lather and Luxury". Quando il suo amore d'infanzia Gavin arriva in città per aiutarla a migliorare il suo modello di business, inizialmente rifiuta.

programme.title: Love on Harbor island
programme.desc: Lily è una giovane interior designer che abita a Seattle, ma è nata e cresciuta in un piccolo paese, dove sua zia Maggie gestisce un b&b. Avendo bisogno d'aiuto, Maggie chiama la nipote per aiutarla a gestire l'azienda. Lì incontra l'affascinante Marcus.

programme.title: Tentazioni Irresistibili
programme.desc: Tre uomini devono affrontare la loro dipendenza dal sesso e continuare a vivere una vita normale in una New York dalle mille tentazioni. Con Mark Ruffalo e Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Ti va di ballare?
programme.desc: La vita di un vedovo prende una svolta inaspettata quando si mette in viaggio per cercare l'amore perduto di un uomo che sta morendo.

programme.title: Unestate a Firenze
programme.desc: L'incontro tra un giocatore di football americano e una ragazza in visita alla cugina. Un amore che nasce sullo sfondo di Firenze.

programme.title: Il ragazzo dei miei sogni
programme.desc: Troppo impegnata con il lavoro, Susan chiede alla sua assistente Abby di trovare l'uomo perfetto per lei. Abby si mette alla ricerca e seleziona Dan, ma finisce per innamorarsene proprio lei.

programme.title: Un ballo per Natale
programme.desc: L'insegnante di danza classica OLIVIA (30 anni) ottiene più di quanto si aspettasse quando sceglie la talentuosa LILY (8 anni) come protagonista nel recital di Natale de Lo Schiaccianoci, e si ritrova a innamorarsi del bellissimo padre pompiere di Lily, MICHAEL (30 anni)

programme.title: Tre cuori
programme.desc: Marc in temporanea trasferta da Parigi in una cittadina di provincia, una sera perde il treno che doveva riportarlo nella capitale, incontra casualmente Sylvie e passeggia con lei senza meta fino al mattino. Strada facendo parlano di tutto, tranne che di loro stessi, scoprendosi due anime affini. Al mattino Marc prende il primo treno, ma prima di salire a bordo, si dà appuntamento con Sylvie nella capitale, qualche giorno dopo. Entrambi non sanno nulla dell'altro, ma sanno che questo è molto più di un gioco, è il destino ad averli fatti incontrare. Sylvie si presenta all'appuntamento, ma Marc ha un contrattempo e arriva con grande ritardo. Nonostante tutto non si dà per vinto e cerca ugualmente la donna, finendo per trovare qualcun altro: Sophie. Ma il destino sta giocando di nuovo a rimpiattino con Marc, perché in realtà Sophie è la sorella di Sylvie. È così che Marc e Sylvie si incontrano nuovamente. La loro armonia esiste ancora… ma è troppo tardi..

programme.title: Love n' Dancing
programme.desc: Siamo nel 2002: Jake Mitchell è un campione di danza swing che vince insieme a Corinne, sua partner nella vita e nella danza, il campionato mondiale. Jake è un ballerino particolare: è sordo per via di un'infezione all'orecchio da quando era adolescente, ma, nonostante questo, ha imparato a sentire le vibrazioni della musica in un modo tutto suo e ha iniziato a ballare. Oggi Jack è diventato un insegnante di ballo in giro per il mondo. Jessica Donovan è una insegnante di inglese, che ha abbondanato il sogno di ballare a Broadway per un lavoro più sicuro. Ha una relazione con Kent, ma tra i due le cose non vanno. Quando Jack e Jessica si incontrano è subito scintilla, non solo nella vita ma anche sul palco: i due, infatti, provano a competere per il nuovo campionato del mondo. Riusciranno a trionfare come coppia di ballo e non solo?

programme.title: Me Without You
programme.desc: Londra, primi anni Settanta. Nell'assolato pomeriggio estivo di un bel quartiere residenziale, Holly e Marina si giurano amicizia eterna. Sono solo due bambine, ma sapranno tenere fede alla promessa fatta per anni, attraversando tre decenni e complicate vicissitudini familiari e sentimentali. ..

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: Un'altra giovinezza
programme.desc: Dominic, anziano linguista ossessionato dallo studio del linguaggio, viene colpito da un fulmine e inizia a ringiovanire, acquisendo poteri paranormali. Tra fughe dai nazisti e scoperte straordinarie, il suo percorso lo porta a riscrivere il destino della sua vita e dei suoi studi.

programme.title: Misstake
programme.desc: In una villa rurale alle porte di Vicenza si riuniscono un gruppo strampalato di tipi umani. Tutti sono lì per lo stesso motivo: ambiscono al possesso della casa. Quando uno degli ospiti muore improvvisamente, le divergenze tra loro si inaspriscono.

programme.title: L'uomo dal futuro
programme.desc: Brasile, 2011. Joao, chiamato da tutti Zero, è un brillante fisico che, nonostante sia a capo di uno dei più grandi progetti scientifici del paese, ha ancora in testa la notte di venti anni prima in cui è stato tradito e umiliato pubblicamente a una festa dalla fidanzata Helena. Quando infine i suoi modi eccentrici e capricciosi rischiano di farlo licenziare, Joao decide di provare prima del tempo la sua invenzione, una macchina che dovrebbe essere una nuova fonte di energia sostenibile per l'umanità. Con grande sorpresa, la macchina apre invece un varco temporale che riporta Joao a quella fatidica notte del 1991, a poche ore prima che Helena lo lasciasse per il popolare playboy Ricardo. Deciso a cambiare l'ordine naturale degli eventi, Joao combina un pasticcio di cui si renderà conto una volta tornato nel presente.

programme.title: Unico nell'isola della Magia
programme.desc: In questo film Unico conosce Cherry e suo fratello che lavora per il malvagio mago Kuruku. Questo malvagio mago ha l'ossessione di trasformare tutti in marionette. L'obiettivo del piccolo unicorno sarà quello di sconfiggere il folle Kuruku e riportare la pace nel mondo. Il secondo film inedito intitolato: Unico nell'isola della magia, arriva per la prima volta doppiato in lingua italiana.

programme.title: Una ragazza a Las Vegas
programme.desc: L'ex spogliarellista di lap dance Beth aspira a diventare una cameriera di cocktail di Las Vegas, quando incontra Dink, un giocatore d'azzardo, che la assume come sua assistente. Beth si rivela essere una specie di prodigio del gioco d'azzardo - con grande rabbia della moglie di Dink, Tulip.

programme.title: 17 anni: e come uscirne vivi
programme.desc: La vita alla scuola superiore diventa ancora più insopportabile per Nadine, quando la sua migliore amica, Krista, inizia a uscire con suo fratello più grande.

programme.title: First Sunday
programme.desc: Ice Cube e Tracy Morgan sono due ladri senza speranza in FIRST SUNDAY, una commedia vergognosamente divertente interpretata da Katt Williams e Chi McBride. Condannato a 5.000 ore di servizi sociali, la vita di Durell Jefferson (Cube) peggiora in men che non si dica. Dopo aver capito che Dio aiuta chi si aiuta, alla fine decide di aiutare se stesso con i fondi di costruzione della chiesa del vicinato. Accompagnato dal suo stupido partner Lee John (Morgan), i due di poca fortuna scoprono che i contanti sono già stati rubati, così tengono la congregazione in ostaggio nel tentativo di scoprire chi sia scappato con il loro bottino! Con la partecipazione di Tiffany New York Pollard, Rickey Smiley, Loretta Devine e Malinda Williams.

programme.title: Biancaneve al college
programme.desc: In una commedia universitaria che rivisita in chiave moderna una storia antica, “Sydney White” racconta di una matricola maschiaccio che lascia le sue infide consorelle e trova una nuova casa con un gruppo di emarginati molto sfigati. Stufa del modo in cui sono stati trattati, dichiara guerra contro l'élite del campus.

programme.title: Un Week-end Da Bamboccioni
programme.desc: Per ricordare l'ex allenatore morto di recente, cinque ex giocatori della squadra di basket si ritrovano, trent'anni dopo il diploma, nella casa sul lago dove hanno celebrato la loro vittoria più grande. Durante il weekend del quattro luglio, i cinque amici si rendono conto che, anche se cresciuti hanno messo su famiglia, non hanno perso quel vecchio smalto.

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Teste di Quoio
programme.desc: Quattro terroristi assaltano l'ambasciata sbagliata a Roma, scatta l'allarme e restano bloccati

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: House Broken
programme.desc: Un uomo, per godersi la meritata pensione, decide di mandare via di casa i figli, disoccupati e scansafatiche.

programme.title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
programme.desc: Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: Uno anzi due

Il ragazzino si dimostra subito simpatico e finisce per legare subito con Jed. Al contrario Martha, ancora in preda al ricordo dei figli non riesce ad accettare lui e la sua presenza. sorpresa.

Ma durante il viaggio accade l'inimmaginabile e la vita dei due giovani cambierà per sempre quando diventeranno protagonisti di uno dei più efferati omicidi domestici degli anni 90. Uno spaccato crudo e violento di una generazione raccontato dalle pagine di cronaca che hanno sconvolto l'America.

programme.title: Airplane vs. Volcano

I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Triassic World

programme.title: Ice 2020
programme.desc: E ‘il 2020. I risultati di uno scienziato ambientale, il Professor Thom Archer suggeriscono che Halo, l'impresa di perforazione della società energetica sul ghiacciaio della Groenlandia ne stanno causando lo scioglimento. Gli avvertimenti di Archer vengono ignorati, così si dirige verso l'Artico per trovare prove inconfutabili. Al suo arrivo, si rende conto che l'umanità è in pericolo immediato, e corre a casa per salvare la sua famiglia. Il ghiacciaio collassa, con conseguenze devastanti...

Marito esemplare di una donna volgare, viene coinvolto nelle indagini sul presunto omicidio di una presunta modella, affiancato da due maldestri poliziotti, Persico e Arciello, il primo di famiglia benestante che ha scelto di arruolarsi in polizia solo per darsi tono, il secondo per assicurarsi uno stipendio. Ritrovandosi ben presto ad affrontare i pericoli della frontiera, Jay si allea con un misterioso viaggiatore di nome Silas (Michael Fassbender), che accetta di proteggerlo in cambio di contanti. Lungo la strada, Jay si renderà conto che l'America, piena di insidie, doppi giochi e violenza, non è il luogo ideale per gli innocenti.

Millie, infatti, mamma single di otto tra bambini e ragazzi, molti dei quali presi in affido per strapparli alla strada, viene dapprima ingiustamente arrestata e poi, una volta liberatasi, è costretta a tornare nell'occhio del ciclone alla ricerca di tre dei suoi piccoli, che sono imprudentemente usciti di casa.

Dopo aver assistito ad un brutale pestaggio,l'editore Britt Reid e l'amico Kato, uniscono le proprie le forze per fare giustizia nei corrotti bassifondi della città.

programme.title: Road to Paloma
programme.desc: Il nativo americano Robert Wolf è inseguito dall'Fbi dopo essersi fatto giustizia con le proprie mani e aver vendicato così la madre, prima violentata e poi uccisa.

programme.title: Spacewalker: Il tempo dei primi

programme.title: The wheather man

programme.title: Storie Di Clinica
